skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of real estate valuation, the necessity of real estate valuation, the nature and factors affecting the value and price of real estate, the bases and principles of real estate valuation, the process of real estate valuation, and the role and ethical standards of a real estate appraiser.
Apply mathematical methods to analyze and adjust data for comparative and cost approaches in real estate valuation.
Work effectively in teams, take responsibility, and demonstrate professionalism in real estate valuation tasks.
Present and defend personal viewpoints in the field of real estate valuation.
Adhere to ethical standards and social responsibility in professional and societal contexts.
Analyze and synthesize information to develop and present arguments in real estate valuation.
Plan and manage resources effectively in real estate valuation tasks.
